name: goal-inner-by
text:
import Prelude
def k : Nat → Nat := by
  exact (by intro x; exact x)
note: the host prints a nondependent function type without its binder; the self-hosted server keeps the frontend's (`(x0 : Nat) → Nat`)

knownGap.reason: a goal whose target is a function type prints its binder (`⊢ (x0 : Nat) → Nat`) where the host drops it (`⊢ Nat → Nat`)
